title: RAG — AI Answers from Your Files
summary: RAG = AI answers from your files — not fine-tuning, not guessing

sections.heading: Orientation — Lesson Start
sections.subtitle: Lesson Start
sections.contentMarkdown:
- **What will you understand?** **RAG (AI answers from your files)** = **answers from your data instead of guessing**.
- **Why now?** **When your assistant in the app responds to prices or policies**, **it must read from your data** — **not from its general memory**.
- **What after the lesson?** **A simple design map:** **One source + 3 questions answered from it** — **not code**.
- **Optional depth:** **Builder level 3**. **If your goal is to use AI only in your work — it’s not required**.

sections.heading: Tension — AI Gave an Incorrect Price
sections.subtitle: AI Gave an Incorrect Price
sections.contentMarkdown:
- **You ask GPT about your product's price** — **it responds with «29 dollars»**. **You never sent this price!**
- **AI guesses an answer that seems logical** — **this is hallucination**. **The customer loses trust**.
- **The problem is not with AI** — **the problem is that it did not read your data before answering**.

sections.heading: Core Idea — RAG = Answers from Your Files — Not Guessing
sections.subtitle: RAG = Answers from Your Files — Not Guessing
sections.contentMarkdown:
- **Before AI answers**, **the system searches your files**, **finds the correct snippet**, **and tells AI: «answer only from this document»**.
- **RAG** = **search your files + add the snippet to the question + write the answer**.
- **RAG is not fine-tuning:** **fine-tuning changes the model itself**. **RAG injects your files at the time of the question** — **without touching the model**.
- **If the information is not in your files** — **«I don’t know» is better than making things up**.

sections.heading: Comparison — Direct Question vs. Reading Your Files First
sections.subtitle: Direct Question vs. Reading Your Files First
sections.contentMarkdown:
| AI Question from Memory | RAG from Your Files |
|--------------------------------|---------------|
| «What is the return policy?» — **guesses from general information**. **Incorrect answer = angry customer** | **the system finds the paragraph «return policy» in your PDF**, **adds it to the prompt**, **and AI responds from it**. **Accuracy from your data** |

sections.contentMarkdown:
| Term | Meaning | Example |
|---------|--------|------|
| **RAG** | **AI answers from your files** — **searches your sources first and then writes** | **like an employee opening the price file before responding to the customer** — **not from memory** |

sections.heading: Screenshot Block (Intent)
sections.contentMarkdown:
**3 Steps in the Background:**

(1) **the question turns into a search in your files**. (2) **the closest paragraphs (chunks) return**. (3) **the question + paragraphs are sent to AI** — **it answers from your document, not guessing**.

Write all possible answers in a manual table**.**

sections.heading: Mission — Choose One Source for AI
sections.subtitle: Choose One Source for AI
sections.contentMarkdown:
**Introduction:** **Design map — not code**. **10 minutes**.

**Submission:** **Your app in one line**, **one source** (name, type, why it’s important), **3 customer questions**, **alternative response if the answer is not in the source**.

**Evaluation Criteria:**

| Dimension | Weight | Criteria |
|-------|-------|---------|
| Clear Source | 60% | **One specific source** — **not «all files» in general**; **a logical reason for its importance** |
| Realistic Questions | 40% | **3 real customer questions** — **the answer from the source, not guessing** |
